title: Parameter-Space Error Localization and Posterior Fidelity of Physics-Informed Neural Network Forward Surrogates in Bayesian Inverse Problems
description:
Parameter-Space Error Localization and Posterior Fidelity of Physics-Informed Neural Network Forward Surrogates in Bayesian Inverse Problems

Official preprint and computational reproducibility suite accompanying the research paper submitted to the Journal of Computational Physics (Elsevier).

This study demonstrates that surrogate approximation errors enter Bayesian posteriors strictly through sparse sensor projections and localized likelihood filtering. We establish quantitative Total Variation and Wasserstein-1 stability scaling bounds O(sigma_noise^-2), demonstrate the diagnostic predictive superiority of posterior-weighted and likelihood diagnostics over uniform global errors across 240 PDE models, formulate the Bayesian Fidelity Ratio (BFR), and reveal an observational projection crossover in 2D Incompressible Navier-Stokes and 5D multi-mode diffusion.
